name: Daniel Davila
title: Founder & CEO of AMBRA Live Productions
bio: Daniel Davila specializes in the intersection of AI, XR, and robotics/hardware development, blending cutting-edge technology with artistic live performances through his company, AMBRA Live Productions. He graduated from Berklee College of Music with a double major in Music Business Management and Electronic Music Production and Sound Design for XR. At Berklee, he stood out not only as an artist but also as a community leader and founder of Berklee Peru, the largest student club dedicated to a single country in the entire American continent. He has served as a judge for MIT tech hackathons, collaborated as an organizer for HarvardXR (focused on virtual reality, AI, and spatial computing), and currently leads AMBRA Live Productions, a company that merges art and technology to deliver high-level live experiences. The company aims to become a leader in entertainment and social innovation. He is also deeply committed to inclusion, the visibility of Latin American cultures, and the creation of opportunities for emerging talent both in the United States and abroad.
